desc.zh: 从最长可容纳词段推导空格分配，逐步检查末行与单词行例外。
desc.en: Derive maximal word groups and even spacing, then inspect last-line and single-word exceptions.

complexity: O(n + mW) time; O(W) auxiliary space, excluding O(mW) output

concepts.name: maximal fitting prefix
concepts.description: Accept consecutive words only while letters plus minimum gaps fit.

concepts.name: quotient and remainder
concepts.description: Give leftmost remainder gaps one extra space.

concepts.name: loop invariant
concepts.description: Maintain a consecutive fitting group and advance without losing words.
